# Template-shaped output (public-safe)

Readers take a page for generated when several stock patterns turn up together; no one pattern proves it. The aim is output that
reads as made for the subject. `scripts/check_voice.py` reports the prose patterns as advice (never errors); the rest is review.

## Prose (checked as advice)
- **dash-density:** more than one em dash, spaced en dash or ` -- ` per 300 words. Use a full stop, comma or colon.
- **negative-parallelism:** "not just X but Y", "it is not X, it is Y". Say what it is.
- **trailing-ing:** a clause ending ", highlighting …", ", ensuring …", ", fostering …". End the sentence, or give the effect its own sentence with a number.
- **vague-attribution:** "experts believe", "studies show". Name the source and date, or cut.
- **stock-verb:** leverage, underscore, navigate, harness, foster, elevate, empower, realm, pivotal, "evolving landscape". Landscape as a landform is fine. <!-- idiom-ok -->
- **stacked-triplets:** two or more three-item runs in a paragraph. Vary the count.
- **uniform-paragraphs:** four or more paragraphs within 15% of one length.

## Pages and figures (review, Default)
- No emoji or sparkle icons as feature marks; no purple-to-blue gradient; no glass or glow outside the Outcrop register.
- No centred hero over three equal icon cards; no pill badge above the headline; no single accent-coloured word in a headline.
- One spacing scale and one radius and shadow set from the tokens; hover and focus states differ by purpose, not by one lift.
- Charts reset the library default: palette, legend position, gridlines, title and font, bar-end rounding.
- No unverifiable round claims ("10x", "99%"); every number traces to data.
